summary: Solve the Ronnmark determinant for complex kx at each supplied angular frequency from one fixed seed.

capability: Solve the Ronnmark determinant for complex kx at each supplied angular frequency from one fixed seed.
operation: solve the Ronnmark determinant for complex kx roots
angular-frequency sequence and fixed kx seed to signed complex roots and exit diagnostics
discovery.boundary: multiple signed roots may exist; exit flags and residuals expose nonconvergence without mirroring roots

identity.relation: angular-frequency sequence and fixed kx seed to signed complex roots and exit diagnostics
identity.direction: angular-frequency sequence and fixed kx seed to signed complex roots and exit diagnostics
identity.definition: Each frequency independently starts from kx_start and solves det(D)=0 with source-compatible complex trust-region dogleg arithmetic and bounded iteration/evaluation counts.
identity.coordinates: complex perpendicular wavenumber plane; frequencies remain in caller order
identity.boundary: multiple signed roots may exist; exit flags and residuals expose nonconvergence without mirroring roots
assumptions: Input units and normalization follow the declared ports; no physical parameters are inferred.

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: Background magnetic-field strength, entering the cyclotron frequency through the dispersion determinant

inputs.name: qs
inputs.description: Species charges, setting the sign of the cyclotron frequency
inputs.constraints: Finite; element count matches the other species arrays.

inputs.name: ms
inputs.description: Species masses, entering the thermal speed and the cyclotron frequency

inputs.name: ns0
inputs.description: Species absolute number densities, entering the plasma frequency

inputs.name: Ts0
inputs.description: Species temperatures, already converted to kelvin under the declared convention

inputs.name: omegas
inputs.description: Angular-frequency sequence whose roots are sought; each frequency point is solved independently with the same `kx_start` initial value, with no continuation between frequencies
inputs.constraints: Non-empty finite array with nonzero elements, because the frequency appears in the resonance denominator.

inputs.name: kz
inputs.description: Wavevector component parallel to the magnetic field, held fixed and entering the parallel resonance argument
inputs.constraints: Finite; zero is allowed (case 2 uses `kz=0.0`), in which case the parallel resonance argument reduces to $\omega/\omega_{cs}$.

inputs.name: kx_start
inputs.description: Starting complex initial value for continuation root finding, `x01=(0.6+0.0i)*kn`
inputs.constraints: Finite; it only affects which root is converged to, not the existence of the root itself.

inputs.name: tol_fun
inputs.description: Relative residual convergence tolerance corresponding to the reference runtime `TolFun`
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; defaults to `1e-16` (the reference solver default).

inputs.name: tol_x
inputs.description: Relative variable-step convergence tolerance corresponding to the reference runtime `Tolx`
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; defaults to `1e-16` (the reference solver default).

inputs.name: max_iterations
inputs.description: Maximum iterations per frequency point, corresponding to the reference runtime `MaxIter`
inputs.constraints: At least 1; defaults to 400 (the reference runtime default).

inputs.name: max_function_evals
inputs.description: Maximum objective-function evaluations per frequency point, corresponding to the reference runtime `MaxFunEvals`
inputs.constraints: At least 1; defaults to 100 (the reference runtime uses `100*numel(x0)` for a scalar unknown).

outputs.name: roots
outputs.description: Complex perpendicular-wavenumber root obtained at each frequency point

outputs.name: residuals
outputs.constraints: Finite complex; the quality of the root must be judged from this residual together with `last_updates`.

outputs.name: determinant_scale
outputs.description: Maximum modulus of the dielectric-tensor elements at each root, used as the cancellation scale of the determinant residual at that frequency point
outputs.constraints: Nonnegative finite; `abs(residuals)/determinant_scale` is the relative zero quality of that root.

outputs.name: exit_flags
outputs.description: The reference runtime `fsolve` exit flag at each frequency point (`1` residual met, `2` step met, `3` residual decrease met, `-2` Jacobian degenerate, `-3` trust region shrank to meaninglessness, `0` iteration or evaluation limit reached)

outputs.name: iterations
outputs.description: Iteration count actually used at each frequency point

outputs.name: function_evals
outputs.description: Objective-evaluation count actually used at each frequency point

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: Whether the exit flag is positive at each frequency point (that is, the reference runtime judged convergence)
outputs.constraints: When false, the root is still a numerical stationary point or an unconverged point of the determinant; the caller must decide acceptance from `residuals` and `determinant_scale`.

outputs.name: omegas
outputs.description: Angular-frequency sequence actually used in this call, echoing the input

outputs.name: kz
outputs.description: Parallel wavenumber used in this root finding, echoing the input

outputs.name: kx_start
outputs.description: Starting initial value used in this root finding, echoing the input

outputs.name: tol_fun
outputs.description: Residual threshold used in this call, echoing the input

outputs.name: tol_x
outputs.description: Variable threshold used in this call, echoing the input

outputs.name: max_iterations
outputs.description: Iteration limit used in this call, echoing the input

outputs.name: max_function_evals
outputs.description: Evaluation limit used in this call, echoing the input

outputs.name: solver
outputs.description: Text label for the root-finding algorithm, so the caller can check the numerical path used

preconditions: multiple signed roots may exist; exit flags and residuals expose nonconvergence without mirroring roots
supported: Solve the Ronnmark determinant for complex kx at each supplied angular frequency from one fixed seed.
excluded: No mode identity or arbitrary-parameter accuracy is inferred beyond the declared numerical method.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for declared invalid inputs; numeric conversion errors may propagate for unsupported Python objects.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Numerical backend errors propagate; no fallback relation is substituted.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Exit flags and residuals expose bounded nonconvergence.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after an exception.

python.signature: solve_kinetic_wavevector_roots(*, B0, qs, ms, ns0, Ts0, omegas, kz, kx_start, tol_fun=1e-16, tol_x=1e-16, max_iterations=400, max_function_evals=100)

example.description: Evaluate one bounded case. Python preflight ran locally; local execution covers this asset.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import solve_kinetic_wavevector_roots
r=solve_kinetic_wavevector_roots(B0=1.0, qs=[-1.60217662e-19], ms=[9.1094e-31], ns0=[6.075e19], Ts0=[11604941.036704937],omegas=[1e11],kz=0,kx_start=8000); assert len(r['roots'])==1
example.expected: Python preflight returned one converged root 6.01073715e-13 + 1315.20499512j with residual about -1.14e-13 - 2.86e-17j and exit flag 1. local execution covers this asset.
